notablePrerequisites:
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
Barrenton Medic has less than three -1/-1 counters on it.
It is your turn.
description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, preventing the next one damage dealt to it this turn.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
The Snake enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
